title: Overnight Orchestrator (Log Is The Proof)
style: orchestrator anthem, 96 bpm, deadpan log-recital rap, terminal core, overnight-run vibe, dry kick, sparse synth, ledger groove, byte-count discipline, five-AM completion flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Overnight orchestrator dot log two point three MB
Five AM timestamp the run completed quietly
Bifrost sync dot SH five KB the script
May sixth the engine on the dipped

[Pre-Chorus]
Rsync log o seven oh five eleven twenty
Twelve point seven MB the bytes plenty

[Chorus]
Overnight orchestrator overnight orchestrator
The log writes itself the engine no waiter
Five AM the run completed clean
The sync tells the truth on the screen

[Verse 2]
Manifest dot TSV three point eight MB the index
Sync dot log nine thirteen bytes the brief
VDS sample hashes empty placeholder
VDS diff empty placeholder cold ledger

[Bridge]
The orchestrator runs while the operator sleeps
The log proves the run the byte count keeps

[Outro]
Overnight orchestrator the log is the proof
Five AM completion the lane on the roof
